description: This file provides wrappers for hash-based message authentication code (HMAC) functions, supporting multiple cryptographic libraries, and including specific implementations for MD5, SHA1, SHA256, and SHA512.

methods.name: int li_hmac_md5(unsigned char digest[MD5_DIGEST_LENGTH],const void * const secret,const uint32_t slen,const unsigned char * const msg,const uint32_t mlen)
methods.description: Computes MD5 HMAC for the given message using the secret key.

methods.name: int li_hmac_sha1(unsigned char digest[SHA_DIGEST_LENGTH],const void * const secret,const uint32_t slen,const unsigned char * const msg,const uint32_t mlen)
methods.description: Computes SHA1 HMAC for the given message using the secret key with support for multiple crypto backends.

methods.name: int li_hmac_sha256(unsigned char digest[SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH],const void * const secret,const uint32_t slen,const unsigned char * const msg,const uint32_t mlen)
methods.description: Computes SHA256 HMAC for the given message with support for multiple crypto backends.

methods.name: int li_hmac_sha512(unsigned char digest[SHA512_DIGEST_LENGTH],const void * const secret,const uint32_t slen,const unsigned char * const msg,const uint32_t mlen)
methods.description: Computes SHA512 HMAC for the given message with support for multiple crypto backends.
